comments.body: I think you could forget Zurich. If you’re quite fluent in German the people will speak in Swyzerdutch and you won’t understand anything. From the other POV Swiss German people are more open and they will try to speak in English. In Lausanne people are cold and quite attached to their French culture and language (they feel minored from the German part) and not so open to foreign languages. If you’re not fluent in German simply forget Zurich and try to spend more time on the weekends in Bern (1h train) in Geneva or Neuchâtel or Biel/Bienne where people are more open as in Lausanne
comments.author: Iphilbour
